title: docs(tonewood): FPL GTR-282 values for covered species (tranche 2)
intent: Tranche 2 of the tonewood library verification: add FPL GTR-282 (2021) shrinkage and mechanical tables as a reference, check every density/SG/Janka/MOE/MOR/shrinkage and derived acoustic value for FPL-covered species against it strictly, correct the documents and the prose built on the old numbers, and resolve open issues O-04, O-06 (except Granadillo), O-07 and O-09. Includes the review fixes recorded as C-12 (extractor control-character defect, strict alias resolution, range reporting, --fix re-check, PDF hash validation). Also applies the owner's source-label ruling (C-13): table-specific FPL_GTR282_table_4-3/4-4/5-3a/5-4a/5-5a labels in CLAUDE.md and the wood-species update template, with FPL_GTR282_table_5-3 deprecated, not redefined.
behavior_change: none - documentation (including the CLAUDE.md data-policy source labels), a reference CSV, and two standalone scripts under scripts/ that the application does not import. wood_species.json and every other data file, route, schema and workflow are untouched.

diff_articulation.what_changed: docs/reference/fpl-gtr282 (CSV + README with SHA-256 provenance); scripts/extract_fpl_gtr282_tables.py; scripts/check_tonewood_fpl_values.py; 640 checked cells in 13 docs now equal FPL (418 + 18 rewritten by --fix, 3 out-of-range ranges and the top-woods doc by hand), prose claims rewritten where the numbers changed rankings; CITES_STATUS.md adds Bagtikan (not listed) and the 2026 EU Annex D Shorea s.l. listing; VERIFICATION_LOG.md C-11, C-12 and updated open issues. CLAUDE.md and docs/process/wood_species_update_template.md: FPL source labels are table-specific; the old FPL_GTR282_table_5-3 is deprecated (no data record used it).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Tranche 1 left FPL-covered species on unsourced or regression values (e.g. pignut hickory Janka 902 vs FPL 2,136 lbf; mahogany MOE 11.97 vs 10.3) and several rankings were wrong as a result. The checker makes the FPL attribution re-runnable.

commands_run: py -3.11 scripts/extract_fpl_gtr282_tables.py <pdfs> docs/reference/fpl-gtr282/fpl_gtr282_species_tables.csv -> both SHA-256 ok; 4-3:115, 4-4:82, 5-3a:113, 5-4a:27, 5-5a:75 species, 0 problems, 0 control bytes, exit 0
metric vs FPL inch-pound twins (5-3b/5-4b/5-5b): 1,397 values checked, 1,390 agree; 7 are FPL-internal inconsistencies (listed in the README)

py -3.11 scripts/check_tonewood_fpl_values.py --summary -> 119 aliases resolve; 640 cells checked, 0 mismatches; 9 range cells not compared (0 exclude the FPL value); 1299 skipped (species not mapped), exit 0
stale-number scan of non-table lines for every replaced value -> only unchanged values and thresholds remain
Species+ (speciesplus.net search API): Parashorea / malaanonan -> 0 records; Dipterocarpaceae -> 186 species in 7 genera, cites_listing NC, eu_listing D (Reg. (EU) 2026/1383, effective 2026-06-29)
wood-database.com: ovangkol Janka 1,330 lbf; guanacaste 470 lbf; african-padauk 1,710 lbf; no page for Platymiscium yucatanum
negative control: extractor with one byte appended to 62244.pdf -> SHA-256 MISMATCH, no CSV written, exit 1
negative control: checker with the mora alias pointed at 'Mora (Mor spp.)' -> 'no FPL row', nothing checked, exit 1
negative control: --fix with a no-op rewriter and a perturbed FPL value -> re-check reports 7 mismatches, exit 1; docs byte-identical
git grep FPL_GTR282_table_5-3 -> only CLAUDE.md, the template, and the docs that describe the deprecation; 0 uses in wood_species.json or code
